resources.title: Things That Can Help You Bloom
resources.intro: Sometimes, the next step starts with finding the right information. This space is being built to help Bloomies discover useful opportunities, learning materials, and resources for their journey.

categories.title: Opportunities
categories.description: Useful opportunities that can help girls learn, grow, connect, and explore what is possible.

items.title: Scholarships
items.description: Scholarship opportunities and funding information for girls and young people.

items.title: Youth & Girls' Programs
items.description: Programs, initiatives, and communities created to support girls and young people.

items.title: Fellowships & Challenges
items.description: Fellowships, competitions, challenges, and other opportunities to learn and participate.

categories.title: Learning
categories.description: Resources that can help Bloomies build skills, explore interests, and keep learning.

items.title: Technology
items.description: Beginner-friendly resources for exploring technology, digital skills, and creativity.

items.title: Career Exploration
items.description: Resources for exploring different career paths, skills, industries, and possibilities.

items.title: Speaking & Communication
items.description: Resources to help girls communicate clearly, express themselves, and build confidence with their voices.

categories.title: Personal Growth
categories.description: Resources for navigating everyday life, building confidence, developing leadership, and taking care of yourself.

items.title: Confidence
items.description: Ideas and resources for building self-belief, self-expression, and confidence.

items.title: Wellbeing
items.description: Resources focused on emotional wellness, healthy habits, self-care, and personal wellbeing.

items.title: Leadership
items.description: Resources for girls who want to develop leadership skills and make a difference around them.

items.title: Life Skills
items.description: Practical resources for navigating school, relationships, decisions, opportunities, and everyday life.

featuredResource.title: You Are Allowed to Start Small
featuredResource.description: You do not need to have everything figured out before taking your next step. Sometimes progress begins with one question, one conversation, one application, one skill, or one small decision.

resourceSubmission.title: Know a resource Bloomies should see?
resourceSubmission.description: If you know about a scholarship, program, learning resource, opportunity, or useful tool that could help girls, you can send it our way.

resourceGuidelines.title: Useful
resourceGuidelines.description: Resources should offer something genuinely useful to girls and young people.

resourceGuidelines.title: Relevant
resourceGuidelines.description: We aim to share resources that connect with the interests, goals, questions, and experiences of Bloomies.

resourceGuidelines.title: Accessible
resourceGuidelines.description: Where possible, resources should be understandable and reasonably accessible to the people they are intended to serve.

resourceGuidelines.title: Responsible
resourceGuidelines.description: Resources should be shared thoughtfully, with attention to safety, accuracy, and the experience of the girls using them.

futureLibrary.description: The resource library is currently structured as a foundation for future dynamic content.
